datasets.name: current_weather_gold
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  temperature,
  feels_like,
  humidity,
  pressure,
  visibility,
  wind_speed,
  wind_direction,
  country,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  load_dt_tm,
  update_dt_tm
FROM
  current_weather_summary
ORDER BY
  update_dt_tm DESC

datasets.name: forecast_weather_gold
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  forecast_date,
  maxtemp,
  mintemp,
  avgtemp,
  sunhour,
  uv_index,
  co,
  pm10,
  load_dt_tm
FROM
  forecast_weather_summary
ORDER BY
  forecast_date

datasets.name: air_quality_gold
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  co,
  no2,
  o3,
  pm10,
  pm25
FROM
  air_quality_summary

datasets.name: weather_trends
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  DATE(update_dt_tm) as date,
  AVG(temperature) as avg_temperature,
  AVG(humidity) as avg_humidity,
  AVG(wind_speed) as avg_wind_speed
FROM
  current_weather_summary
GROUP BY
  city,
  DATE(update_dt_tm)
ORDER BY
  date DESC

datasets.name: city_comparison
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  country,
  temperature,
  humidity,
  wind_speed,
  visibility,
  pressure,
  latitude,
  longitude
FROM
  current_weather_summary
ORDER BY
  temperature DESC

datasets.name: pipeline_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Current Weather' as data_source,
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  MAX(update_dt_tm) as last_refresh,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(update_dt_tm)) as days_since_refresh,
  CASE
    WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(update_dt_tm)) <= 1 THEN 'Fresh'
    WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(update_dt_tm)) <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
    ELSE 'Stale'
  END as data_freshness
FROM
  current_weather_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Forecast Weather' as data_source,
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  MAX(load_dt_tm) as last_refresh,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(load_dt_tm)) as days_since_refresh,
  CASE
    WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(load_dt_tm)) <= 1 THEN 'Fresh'
    WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(load_dt_tm)) <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
    ELSE 'Stale'
  END as data_freshness
FROM
  forecast_weather_summary
